transition.text: Term-limited. Xavier Becerra (Democratic) won the governorship (NBC News projection, unofficial; the National Governors Association lists the same winner) and takes office in January 2027.
Not a candidate for this office on November 3. Fiona Ma (Democratic) won the race for lieutenant governor (NBC News projection, unofficial; CNN's count agrees) and takes office in January 2027.
Not a candidate for this office on November 3. Eleni Kounalakis (Democratic) won the race for treasurer (unofficial results reported by MultiState Elections) and takes office in January 2027.
Not a candidate for this office on November 3. Jane Kim (Democratic) won the race for insurance commissioner (unofficial results reported by MultiState Elections) and takes office in January 2027.

Not a candidate for this office on November 3. Richard Barrera (Nonpartisan) won the race for superintendent of public instruction (unofficial results reported by MultiState Elections) and takes office in January 2027.

statewideTerm: Four-year terms ending in January 2027; officers elected on November 3, 2026 take office then. The Superintendent of Public Instruction is elected on a nonpartisan ballot.

notes.election: A general election was held on November 3, 2026. This roster lists officials in office on the build date; people elected on November 3 take office in January 2027 and are not shown yet.
